violations.text: Firm did not have a copy of the variance approval letter at the facility at time of inspection. If the REGULATORY AUTHORITY grants a VARIANCE as specified in § 8-103.10, or a HACCP PLAN is otherwise required as specified under § 8-201.13, the PERMIT HOLDER shall: (A) Maintain the approved variance at the food establishment. Firm must obtain variance approval letter and keep it at the facility. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2026

Food packaged in the food establishment are lacking label information including but not limited to the "use by date". Labels state "enjoy by". Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, the business name/address, use by date, and all other regulation requirements . Labels must be updated. Per person in charge, the labels will be temporarily handwritten or stickers will be made. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2026

Firm is partially cooling sushi in the blast chiller or freezer and placing the sushi in the display case before completely cooling it to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. Sushi was observed held at 44-49 degrees Fahrenheit in the display case. Per person in charge, sushi had been partially cooled in the blast chiller and was placed in the display case about 2 hours prior to inspection. Sushi was relocated to the blast chiller and cooled to 41 or below at time of inspection. Display case is inadequate for cooling. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specifiedChapter 3. Pf Firm must cool the sushi to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below in the freezer or blast chiller before it is placed in the display case. Cooling logs were given to the person in charge at time of inspection. Please email inspector cooling logs. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

(Shrimp), which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC voluntarily disposed of food at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2024

(Rice bowls with fish and chicken) was observed held at 120 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, food was made and packaged under an hour prior to inspection. Food was reheated over 165 degrees Fahrenheit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Shrimp was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Cooling methods and procedures reviewed with PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2024
